tools.name: getObjectSchema
tools.description: Returns Salesforce schema information optimized for LLM consumption. Call with no parameters for a compact index of queryable business objects, then with an object name for field-level detail (types, required flags, picklist values, relationships) plus admin-authored guidance.

object-name.description: API name of the object. Omit to get the compact index of all objects.

tools.name: soqlQuery
tools.description: Executes a SOQL query to retrieve Salesforce records. Always include a WHERE and a LIMIT clause. Supports relationship queries and subqueries. Maximum 50,000 records per transaction.

query.description: A valid SOQL query string, for example SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Industry = 'Technology' LIMIT 100.

tools.name: find
tools.description: Executes a SOSL text search across multiple Salesforce objects at once. Use when the object is unknown or the term could appear in several objects. Returns at most 2,000 records.

search.description: A valid SOSL search string, for example FIND {Acme} IN NAME FIELDS RETURNING Account(Id, Name), Contact(Id, Name, Email).

tools.name: createSobjectRecord
tools.description: Creates a new Salesforce record. Call getObjectSchema first to learn required fields and valid values. Respects the user permissions and field-level security. Returns the new record Id.

sobject-name.description: API name of the object to create a record for.

body.description: Field-value pairs for the new record.

tools.name: updateSobjectRecord
tools.description: Updates an existing record by Id. Include only the fields to change; omitted fields keep their values. Fails if the record is missing, the user lacks edit permission, or validation fails.

id.description: Salesforce record Id of the record to update.

tools.name: updateRelatedRecord
tools.description: Updates a parent record by traversing a child-to-parent relationship from a child record, up to five levels deep. If the parent Id is known, use updateSobjectRecord instead.

sobject-name.description: API name of the child object to start from, for example Contact.

id.description: Salesforce record Id of the child record.

relationship-path.description: Child-to-parent relationship field that points to the parent, for example Account.

body.description: Field-value pairs to update on the parent record.
